content: त्रय {%a.%} (-यी|{%f.%}) Triple, threefold, treble, divided into three parts, of three kinds; त्रयी वै विद्या ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि <ls>Śat. Br.</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 23</ls>. .{@-यम्@} A triad, a group or collection of three; अदेयमासीत्त्रयमेव भूपतेः शशिप्रभं छत्रमुभे च चामरे <ls>R. 3. 16</ls>; लोकत्रयम् <ls>Bg. 11. 20</ls>, <ls n="Bg. 11.">43</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 76</ls>.

त्रयी .²1 The three Vedas taken collectively (ऋग्यजुःसामानि); त्रयीमयाय त्रिगुणात्मने नमः <ls>K. 1</ls>; तौ त्रयीवर्जमितरा विद्याः परिपाठितौ <ls>U. 2</ls>; <ls>Ms. 4. 125</ls>. .²2 A triad, triplet; व्यद्योतिष्ट सभावेद्यामसौ नरशिखित्रयी <ls>Śi. 2. 3</ls>. .²3 A matron or married woman whose husband and children are living. .²4 Intellect, understanding. .²5 The part of the श्रुति, pertaining to ceremonial acts and sacrifices (कर्मकाण्ड); <ls>Bhāg. 7. 6. 26</ls>.
